name: Kasugai Yuu
source:
"Memories are strange things, aren't they? When I think back to the fun times I had in school, my weary heart warms up, and it gives me the energy to keep going."

A kind, gentle lady who works for a confectionery manufacturer in Tokyo.
Yuu has a laid-back attitude and enjoys baking sweets.
She especially loves visiting cafes and bakeries with her friend Takano, and her social media
feed is chock-full of beautiful pictures.
She is getting married soon, and she requests a painting of the train station from her high school days to decorate the new apartment she'll be sharing with her partner.

[From [url=https://lilja-natsuka.frontwing.co.jp/en/]Official Website[/url]]
